transcript.content: Hello. What brings you into the clinic today?
I’m here because when I know I have to cross a bridge, the fear starts right away—before I’m even on it. My heart pounds, my hands get sweaty on the wheel or armrest, and I feel just terribly afraid.
Does this intense fear happen only when dealing with bridges, or do you experience it in other situations as well?
It’s really the bridges. I know thousands of cars go over them every day, but if I see a high span on a map or coming up through the windshield, it feels like it could just drop away underneath us.
How long have you been dealing with this fear of bridges?
It started after my friend died in an accident near that bridge route. That was about two years and five months ago.
Do you ever experience unwanted, distressing memories of the accident popping into your mind?
No, I don’t really have memories of the accident just popping into my mind.
